$comment: Milestone 2 read-only SELECT catalog for the staging PII DB (pii, PostgreSQL via PgBouncer). Same table as M1 (user_pii_field_value, live schema 2026-10-19).
Only counts, field names and md5 hashes of the ciphertext are selected — never the ciphertext, nonce, tag or any key material. Every query runs inside BEGIN READ ONLY (core/db).

piiRecordsForUser.sql: SELECT tenant_id, user_id, field_name AS field, md5(ciphertext::text) AS ciphertext_hash, updated_at FROM user_pii_field_value WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 ORDER BY field_name
